title: Colgan Air: Why Didn't the Stick Pusher Save It?
description:
The Colgan Air airliner had a machine built to push its nose down out of a stall. Why didn't it work?
We rebuild the stick pusher in 3D from the NTSB's final report: what it does, when it fired, and the hands that pulled against it.
The full minute-by-minute story is on the channel.
Sources: NTSB (Feb 2010).
Based on official investigation reports and published sources. 3D scenes are reconstructions, not actual footage.
